cadence.mad_units: mean absolute BGR channel difference, 0..255, native resolution
cadence.interpretation: Near-held decoded content is consistent with repeated source images plus encoding noise; origin and effective real-time FPS are unverified.
cadence.rule: Preserve original PTS and hold groups; do not compress time or assume every frame is a fresh observation.

edge_circle_cross_check.method: Hough gradient circles on native pixels; search location/radius seeded by baseline, not independent labels
edge_circle_cross_check.note: Agreement supports center consistency only; neither detector is ground truth and both can share errors.

limitations: No verified real-time cadence or replay speed
